name: sanga
description: 京都サンガF.C.に関する非公式Webツールの検証スクリプト集約

scripts.check: npm run check:static && npm run check:squad
scripts.check:static: npm run check:data && npm run check:js && node tools/check-static-assets.mjs && node tools/generate-dom-inventory.mjs --check && npm run check:tools
scripts.check:data: node tools/validate-matches.js && node tools/validate-generated-matches.js public/data/matches.json --expected-count 57 --strict && node tools/validate-hotels.js && node tools/validate-players.js && node tools/validate-tools.js && npm run check:timeline
scripts.check:away-tickets: node --check tools/fetch-away-tickets.js && node --check tools/parse-away-tickets.js && node tools/parse-away-tickets.js tools/fixtures/away-tickets.sample.html tools/fixtures/away-tickets.sample.csv --retrieved-at 2030-07-01T10:00:00+09:00 --check
scripts.check:ticket-sales: node --check tools/fetch-ticket-sales.js && node --check tools/parse-ticket-sales.js && node tools/parse-ticket-sales.js tools/fixtures/ticket-sales.sample.html tools/fixtures/ticket-sales.sample.csv --retrieved-at 2030-07-01T10:00:00+09:00 --check
scripts.check:ticket-sales:current: node tools/generate-calendar-events.js docs/sheets/ticket-sales.current.csv tmp/calendar-events.current.json && node tools/validate-calendar-events.js tmp/calendar-events.current.json
scripts.check:timeline: npm run check:ticket-sales && npm run check:away-tickets && npm run check:ticket-sales:current && node tools/generate-calendar-events.js docs/sheets/ticket-sales.2026-08-28.csv experiments/supporter-timeline/calendar-events.sample.json --samples experiments/supporter-timeline/sample-events.json --check && node tools/validate-calendar-events.js experiments/supporter-timeline/calendar-events.sample.json && npm run check:timeline:public
scripts.check:timeline:public: node tools/generate-calendar-events.js docs/sheets/ticket-sales.current.csv public/data/calendar-events.json --away docs/sheets/away-tickets.current.csv --away-sales docs/sheets/away-sales.manual.csv --check && node tools/validate-calendar-events.js public/data/calendar-events.json
scripts.check:squad: npm run check:squad:js && node tools/validate-players.js && node tools/validate-squad-contract.mjs
scripts.check:squad:js: node --check public/assets/squad-builder.js && node --check public/assets/squad-formations.js && node --check public/assets/squad-sample-players.js && node --check tools/validate-squad-contract.mjs && node --check tools/check-squad-layout.mjs
scripts.check:tools: node --check tools/asset-versions.mjs && node --check tools/ftp-client.mjs && node --check tools/fetch-production-files.mjs && node --check tools/check-import-tools.mjs && node tools/check-import-tools.mjs
scripts.generate:timeline: node tools/generate-calendar-events.js docs/sheets/ticket-sales.2026-08-28.csv experiments/supporter-timeline/calendar-events.sample.json --samples experiments/supporter-timeline/sample-events.json && npm run generate:timeline:public
scripts.generate:timeline:public: node tools/generate-calendar-events.js docs/sheets/ticket-sales.current.csv public/data/calendar-events.json --away docs/sheets/away-tickets.current.csv --away-sales docs/sheets/away-sales.manual.csv
